in_sanskrit.name: अलकन्दा
in_sanskrit.meaning: Immovable, unchanging, beyond the reach of time
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Alaknanda is derived from the Sanskrit words 'alak' (immovable, unchanging) and 'kanda' (source, origin). This name signifies someone who is beyond the reach of time and remains unchanging and immovable, like a source or origin that remains constant. In Hindu mythology, the Goddess Alaknanda is a form of Goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva.

in_hindi.name: अलकन्दा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Alaknanda in Hindi is a combination of the words 'alak' (अलक) and 'kanda' (कन्दा). 'Alak' means immovable or unchanging, and 'kanda' means source or origin. Together, the name Alaknanda signifies someone who is beyond the reach of time and remains unchanging and immovable, like a source or origin that remains constant.

in_marathi.name: Alaknanda
in_marathi.long_meaning: Alaknanda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Alaka means immortal and Kanda means river. This name is derived from the legendary river Alaknanda, which is said to be a part of the sacred Ganges.
